resolution.summary: Fixed microphone dropdown visibility and pointer selection by raising shared body-portaled SelectContent from z-50 to z-300 above Dialog/Sheet z-250. Reproduced live before fix: listbox existed at z50 but hit testing reached dialog instead. Deployed 0aaaceae9 to production and main. Live browser verified listbox z300 and correct hit target; selected QA-Microphone.wav and QA-Camera.mp4, changed channel count, and Escape closed the list while preserving the dialog. Next production build and scoped ESLint passed, candidate/public deployment smoke checks and native persistence release gate passed. Evidence .local/microphone-dropdown/release.json.
